name: Warusa
source:
Main character comes to a private school as an educational intern. He is supposed to follow instructions of his older colleague Oda Eiji who also majors in chemistry. But the problem is that Oda is a sadist and rapist. Will this acquaintance be cure or poison?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公来到一所私立学校担任教育实习生，按照安排，他应当听从资深同事尾田荣二的指导。尾田同样主修化学，问题在于，他还是一个施虐狂和强奸犯。这场相遇对主人公而言，究竟会是治病的良药，还是致命的毒药？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-july-2007-bullet-butlers.html]vndbreview[/url]]
